title: St. Vladimir's Summer Camp
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We’re so excited to welcome you to St. Vlad’s, where adventure meets faith and friendships are built to last! This summer, join us for an unforgettable experience filled with outdoor activities, inspiring discussions, and meaningful connections. Whether it’s gathering around the campfire, exploring God’s creation, or deepening your faith through engaging lessons and fellowship, there’s a place for everyone here.
